definition: Ernst Dieter Dickmanns is a German pioneer of dynamic computer vision and of driverless cars.
details: Dickmanns has been a professor at the University of the Bundeswehr Munich (1975–2001), and visiting professor to Caltech and to MIT, teaching courses on "dynamic vision".

explainer.lead: Ernst Dieter Dickmanns is a German researcher known for pioneering dynamic computer vision and driverless cars. His work connects machines that can interpret changing visual scenes with vehicles that can drive without a human driver.

tiers.eli5: Ernst Dickmanns helped teach computers to understand what they see while things are moving, a bit like how you watch other players during a ball game. He also worked on cars that could drive themselves. He taught these ideas to university students.
tiers.practitioner: Dickmanns's work is relevant to engineers studying vision systems that operate in changing environments and to autonomous-vehicle research. His academic career included professorial teaching on dynamic vision and visits to Caltech and MIT. Specific algorithms, software stacks, or implementation practices are not established here.
